content: {"episode_id":"ep-05027","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. The submitted clinical indication note documents this ordering rationale, establishing the medical necessity of the monitoring service billed under CPT 93229."}
